description.en:
When it awoke, it found itself lying in a warm room.
The unfamiliar environment frightened it and it wanted to leave, but it was in so much pain it could not move.
The door opened, and through it strode a Feline boy with silver hair and a thick tail. He approached it with liniment and gauze in hand, applying the medicine in the bottle to the wound before bandaging it up.
It struggled a little at first, but was too weak to do anything but accept the boy's treatment before falling into a deep slumber.
On the second day, the boy took it back to where it had been found. They wandered through the woods for an entire day until the boy was exhausted and gasping for breath, but in the end found only the remains of two adult fowlbeasts. He built a small grave for them, then turned to it and said:
'Now, both of us are in the same boat.'
The boy took it back to his room, and the tiny nest inside became its new home.
The boy would come check on it every day. He liked to gently wipe its plumage while chatting with it, unconcerned with whether it could understand him.
......
Like that one night, when the boy approached it with a sullen face and said:
'I'm confident I have what it takes to be a strong clan leader or a good brother, but I cannot guarantee I can do both at once.'
The boy sighed as he spoke. He contemplated for a long time, before finally running off to return with a box that smelled nice. Inside was his sister's favorite dish.
......
Like that one afternoon, when the boy approached it with a tinge of melancholy in his voice:
'I want to graciously wish Gnosis success on his new journey, yet I selfishly hope for him to stay.'
Perhaps because he had been bottling it in for so long, the boy spent the next half hour explaining to it the situation of the Edelweiss clan, the difficulties facing Gnosis, and his reluctance to part ways with his best friend. In the end, he sighed again and said, 'Alas, you're the only who can hear me out. I'd better think of a farewell gift for him now.'
......
And like that day when its wounds healed, and the boy took it out to the snowy plains to practice flying. When it was about to take off, he took out a black silk scarf, tied the fabric around its neck, and asked:
'Will you come with me?'
—At that moment, the boy had already decided to set aside the burdens of being a clan leader and depart from the Snow Realm to study abroad.
It simply cocked its head and looked at him.
Of course, it did not know what the boy was worried about, why he was anxious, or why he was sad.
But perhaps, it sensed that the boy, just like it, did not wish to stay confined in a warm room. He wished to soar beneath the blue sky—
It spread its wings and leapt forward.
Then, to the boy's happy, surprised shouts, it took off with the wind.
On that day, it learned to fly once again.
description.zh:
醒来的时候，它正躺在一个温暖的房间里。
陌生的环境令它恐惧，它想要离开，却发现自己疼得动不了。
房门被打开，有着一头银发和一条粗壮尾巴的菲林男孩走了进来。男孩抱着药物和纱布走到它面前，他将药瓶中的药液涂在它的伤口上，随后为它包扎。
它一开始有些挣扎，但它太虚弱了，只能接受男孩的治疗，而后沉沉睡去。
第二天，男孩带它回到它被发现的地方。他们在树林里转了很久，从早上到晚上，直到男孩累得直喘气，最后却只找到两具成年羽兽的残骸。男孩为它们立了一座小坟，而后看着它，说：
“这下我们算是同病相怜了。”
男孩把它带回房间，那里的小窝成了它的新家。
后来，男孩每天都会来看它，他喜欢帮它擦拭羽毛，一边擦，一边对它说话，也不管它听不听得懂。
……
比如那天傍晚，男孩愁眉苦脸地来到它的面前，对它说道：
“我有信心当一个好家主，也有信心当一个好哥哥，但我无法保证，我能同时当一个好家主和一个好哥哥。”
男孩一边说着，一边叹气，他左思右想，最后跑出去拿了个冒着香气的盒子回来，里面是他妹妹最爱吃的食物。
……
又比如那天下午，男孩带着一丝忧郁对它说：
“我想大方地祝福诺希斯能在新的天地大展拳脚，但是，私心又希望他留下来。”
或许是憋了太久，男孩在接下来的半小时里为它详细解释了一遍埃德怀斯家此时的处境、他朋友诺希斯面临的困难，还有他不希望和挚友分别的心情。临到末了，男孩叹了一口气：“唉，也只有你能听我说这些了。我还是想想给他准备什么临别礼物吧。”
……
再比如那一天，它的伤好了，男孩带着它来到雪原之上训练飞行。在它即将再次尝试起飞时，男孩掏出一条黑色的丝巾，围在它的脖子上，然后问它：
“你想和我一起走吗？”
——彼时，男孩已经决定卸下家主的重担，前往雪境之外学习。
它看着他，歪了歪头。
它当然不知道男孩一直在苦恼什么，在为什么忧虑、为什么难过。
但是，或许它感觉到了，男孩和它一样，不想待在温暖的房间里，想要在碧空之下翱翔——
它张开翅膀，向前跃去。
然后，在男孩惊喜的呼喊声中，它乘风而起。
那天，它再次学会了飞翔。
